title: Agent v2.5.0 never becomes healthy on AgentCore Runtime
scenario: The first CI-built agent image deploys cleanly but the Runtime endpoint never becomes ready and invocations fail. Earlier versions were built on laptops. On-call blames a slow /ping. Find the cause in ECR metadata and Runtime logs, fix the GitLab build, and add a blocking architecture gate.
task: Compare ECR and imagetools metadata for the working and failing versions
Fix the build for linux/arm64 (ARM runner or buildx with QEMU)
Implement and wire a blocking image architecture gate
acceptance: Gate decisions on index, multi-arch, attestation and single manifests
Build is arm64, immutable tag, gate inputs published
ANSWER.md names the architecture mismatch with evidence

practices.label: Week 3 Mon - Runtime contract, Docker and ARM64
